reviews.title: Failed to inform customer about flight changes for 2 ways
reviews.text: Failed to inform customer of flight change for 2 ways, no email or SMS receive from them. My Aunt only get to learned that the flight from Don Muang Airport to Ubon Ratchatani Airport had pushed earlier to 14:15 Hrs when arrived at Don Muang Airport today on 24th May 2023, the flight was supposed to be scheduled at Thailand timing 15:05 Hrs, luckily we booked an earlier timing from Singapore to Don Muang Airport via Airasia. They had also told my aunt that the flight (SL627) for 21st June 2023 (14:05Hrs) had been rescheduled, which they also failed to inform via email. Now they (My Aunt) will have to rebooked another airline in order to fit into 21st June 2023 schedule flight from Don Muang to Singapore. They told us that they will definitely dropped an email to us but we did not receive any of it. I had checked on their website to see whether if the flight have any changes for both dates (via booking tickets number), everything still remain unchanged, timing is still at 15:05 Hrs for 24th May 2023 and 21st June 2023 flight is still the same. Just a heads up for people who are travelling from Ubon Ratchatani Airport to Don Muang Airport on 21st June 2023 that my Aunt had reconfirmed with Lion Air customer service at Don Muang Airport that 21st June 2023 (14:05Hrs) schedule had changed. Do be prepared to do your necessary in order not to delay your next flight or schedule. I had attached the after booking ticket and the search booking ticket for today.
reviews.author: Darius T

reviews.title: Absolutely the worst!!!
reviews.text: Can't talk to a human being,have to wait until the read your message on whatsapp. Chnage flights with little notice then they screw up your ticket so you can't check in online. They suck!!!!
reviews.author: Tamara S

reviews.title: Lion Air experience
reviews.text: Lion Air is pretty consistent with delays and operational issues. The transit process is very inconvenient and not very intuitive. Often prints tickets suggesting a direct flight from place of departure to destination when it actually includes a transit in between. Check in is a hit or miss situation. Some places it runs smoothly while others prioritises baggage checked in as cargo over the passengers standing in line without being informed the counter is used for other purposes. Operation of Lion Air is horrible run and very inefficient.
reviews.author: Steven H

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: There has been a two hour delay and they still do not know when we can fly, it made my trio miserable. I hate this airline
reviews.author: hamideh h

reviews.title: broken luggage and zero communication
reviews.text: When I arrived in bali my suitcase was cracked down the middle and missing a wheel and another wheel was damaged. I reported this at the airport and a ticket number and file was made. I was told to submit that form to 2 lion air emails that they provided me. I did that same day. They responded a week later saying they will send me luggage to my hotel in Bali. Even though I expected to be moving hotels every few days I cancelled hotels in order to stay in one location so they could send me the new suitcase (they refused to provide a refund so this was my only option instead of buying a new one at the time) After that, all communication stopped for over a month. No responses to numours emails. By now I had landed in Thailand. It became impossible to lug the suitcase around and I couldn't find any within the airport that were large enough to fit my stuff so I had to pay for 1-month storage at the airport, buy a new suitcase and fit what I could in that one for the month I was in Thailand. Still no emails back at this time so I put another ticket in. Within that ticket, I had to fill out so much info, a waste of time. They would just respond with an auto-reply saying the ticket is under review and then a week later with no reply I would just get an email saying the ticket is closed. This issue started end of February and it is now the middle of May and I am still in the same place. I open a ticket, it gets closed over and over again. I fly almost every month, sometimes 6-7 times within the same month and I have never experienced anything like this before. Ruined my plans in Bali, and created several extra costs including airport storage and a new suitcase, getting from airport to airport was a nightmare in both countries. I would have preferred if they just told me from the beginning they had no intention of replacing anything and saved me the constant disappointment and struggle. Truly shocking
reviews.author: Brit M

reviews.title: Worst airline I’ve been on yet
reviews.text: Was supposed to arrive at 13:30 but didn’t arrive until 14:00 then proceeded to sit and wait on the tarmac for a whole hour. Arrived late and didn’t take off after its intended time. Not book with this airline
reviews.author: David R

reviews.title: Think twice before booking here
reviews.text: Horrible horrible horrible. Customer support does not exist, if you try the WhatsApp service function their AI/chat bot is literally like talking to a wall. Impossible to work with. Also the interface between them and other platforms like opodo is horrible
reviews.author: To T

reviews.title: impossible customer support
reviews.text: they cancelled my flight and rebooking and involuntary flight change was impossible, their links didnt work for me and despite getting past the chatbot to a 'real' person 7 times over 3 days I got no assistance or resolution. ended up booking my own new flight with another carrier and have requested a refund through booking site.
reviews.author: Yvonne L

reviews.title: Avoid- Tired, dirty plane, no room for knees, not even water served- Avoid if possible.
reviews.text: Avoid flying with any Lyon Air service- Our flight had no knee room- We were all hitting seat in front of us, plane was dirty and tired, not even a small bottle of water served. There own policy if required mask wearing not enforced; Many dozens of flyers not wearing masks. Avoid this company if you can.
reviews.author: Getaway722456

reviews.title: Absolute Joke of an Airline
reviews.text: I’ve lived in Asia for 15 years so am familiar with low cost carriers. Lion Air is by far the worst I have ever flown. We arrived with plenty of time. Checked in as a family of 4 with two kids under 13. Got to the gate that was assigned, no staff, no indication our plane where our plane was. No announcement. We the checked the screens to confirm. Different gate number. So we went to the gate number on the screen. Were told by staff to go back to the gate on the boarding pass. Wait there, still nothing. At the last minute we ask another staff member, who tells us we now must go to another gate. When we arrive we are told no boarding, 10 minute delay. So we go to buy water. Arrive back at the gate, to see that they had started boarding and had almost closed the gate. WHAT A JOKE
reviews.author: asianexpat

reviews.title: Beware last minute cancellations
reviews.text: Our flight out was cancelled less than 24 hrs out and we were not notified, found out by accident. Also, the Lion Air site does not accept US credit cards, we were thus forced to rebook through an agency and Lion will not reimburse for any flight not booked directly with them. We have tried for months to communicate with them without any success.
reviews.author: Jcarlton

reviews.title: Don’t ever ever fly with this airplane
reviews.text: I booked ticket on march 24, 2023 from Pekanbaru to Jakarta for business trip with flight date march 26, 2023 at 6.20 and after booked about two hour later got email that lion air cancel my flight with unreasonable operational issues and they didn’t give replacement schedule and ask me voluntarily to choose the date. The funny thing is, they charged me fee almost 40% from oiriginal price for the voluntary reschedule. Please never ever book this airline including their group: batik air and superjet airline or you gonna get the same case like me.
reviews.author: irwansyah davis

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: The flight was delayed with more then one hour. As of that I missed my connection flight to Melbourne. No refunds, no sorry, nothing. To fly on the same day in the evening to Melbourne, I had to buy a new ticket with Batik Air, who are also part of the Lion Air group. Total money loss EUR 500.
reviews.author: Peter v

reviews.title: No AC on Lion Air and they don't care
reviews.text: Was delayed on the tarmac waiting for take off. The plane was very hot with no air circulation or air conditioning. Children were distressed and crying. Passengers trying to fan themselves with the safety instructions flyer. It is very dangerous , especially for children to be overheated. Lion stewardesses seemed to be oblivious to any safety or comfort of their customers. It is the worst flight I have been on in my life and I've been flying for 45 years. I made a complaint to the stewardess when departing the plane and also emailed Lion to complain. I received a generic " thankyou for your comments ,we will discuss in our meetings" No explanation, no apology, . I feel they are putting profit ahead of safety and comfort. This type of complaint appears to be nothing new, so I can only assume Lion truly do not care. I flew a few days later on Air Asia, the cabin was cool on entry and the aircon remained operational at all times. Do not fly with Lion Air if at all possible. They have an attitude that will prove to be deadly.
reviews.author: Joe Stevens

reviews.title: Cramped, but you get from A to B
reviews.text: In comparison to other budget airlines, the Lion Air Boeing 737-900ER definitely feels a bit squished. Luckily, you aren't likely to be on the aircraft for too long and it does get you to where you need to be. Our flight was slightly delayed but that can happen, and the fare we paid was cheaper than any other airline on the same route.
reviews.author: Ezra B

reviews.title: Worst airline ever (2)/worst company in the universe
reviews.text: I arrived at the ticket counter for a 0120 flight at 1250. I had purchased the ticket through a similarly horrid organization called Gotogate. The ticket agent said that I had not paid for the ticket. I showed him the confirmation. He said I hadn't paid Gotogate. I was forced to buy another ticket. I realized when I landed in Ambon that the airline had sent me a request to checkin (in Indonesian), so obviously I had paid for the ticket. The Lion Air agents in Ambon were totally unhelpful, as was Gotogate.
reviews.author: Scott K

reviews.title: Please treasure your life, avoid this airline.
reviews.text: I fly to Bangkok very often, never have I encounter so much turbulence before, so anxious throughout the whole flight. I believed an experienced pilot would be able to minimise it. Not to mentioned how old the plane was and the engine was exhausted and looks like it would stop anytime, last straw was the horrifying landing which was so hard, bags started to drop and feels like the plane was about to crash. Absolutely ban them for life.
reviews.author: svd w

reviews.title: Worst Airline EVER
reviews.text: To be honest, this is the first and last time we will fly Lion Air. Their general reputation for delay, poor service etc is seemingly well founded. From change and cancellation of flights, to delay in baggage delivery at destination, to delay on departure while other airlines were departing on schedule (but Lion Air and related airlines like Super Jet were delayed for bad weather???) In the end the slight benefit in lower price does not compensate for the low quality service that is received. Moving forward booking through Air Asia, Citi, Batik or Garuda, any carrier other than Lion Air, will be made to avoid these inconveniences.
reviews.author: caninB01

reviews.title: WORST COMPANY IN THE WHOLE UNIVERSE
reviews.text: Not even worth to explain the whole story! JUST TRUST ME AND AVOID THIS COMPANY ! Take ANY other option even if you have to pay twice as much!
reviews.author: John Enzzo Cruises

reviews.title: Run away !!!
reviews.text: Delay on delay no reaction no excuses worse airlines in the world they treat passengers as pig it’s completely disgusting
reviews.author: Jakouilledeliege

reviews.title: An absolute disgrace of an airline
reviews.text: Arrived at airport in plenty of time, my ticket Batik but flight with Malindo. At Desk it said flight rescheduled but when I asked "it's on time sir". The flight left 1 hour 20 minutes late and I missed my connection in KL. We sat for 40 minutes on the plane at the gate with no AC there was not one apology issued either by cabin crew or flight deck it's just an accepted fact that lion company will be late. This airline is a disgrace as backed up by many reviews the worst airline 2022, Batik is supposed to be full service a bottle of water and an unknown bun. It's about time the CAA or IATA removed the license from this abomination of an airline the words "customer service" are not in their vocabulary. Travel with any lion group at your own risk nearly 50% flights late and 34% canceled. Never will I fly with them again.
reviews.author: Armo20

reviews.title: Lion Air reroute our flight last minute
reviews.text: The airline reroute our flight in less than a day before our departure. This has caused a significant delay to our travel due to the transit of 4 hours they suddenly add to our flight, while it was originally a direct flight. What a bad experience with Lion Air. Totally not recommended
reviews.author: Violet

reviews.title: Schlimmstes Flugerlebnis seit 30 Jahren
reviews.text: By far the worst airline I came along in the last 30 years - and I travel a lot! Today Medan Check-In: 1 hour waiting while locals overtake regularly. No word from staff. Check-In fine, but suitcase has 4kg overweight. Have to pay. Locals traveling with twice the allowed amount as cabin-baggage. Then our suitcases (standard Samsonite trolleys), in use for almost 20 years all over the world, are suddenly too big for normal Check-In. Have to Check-In at bulky luggage. After the 8th scan in Indonesia they take away our insect-spray! „Too dangerous, internal rule of Lion Air“. Dangerous? Once through the gate there is a 200m long way leading to at approx. 10 gangways! We could have entered at least 4 airplanes along our way to our entry! And approaching and departing passengers running around in the same gangway. THIS is dangerous! Once in the plane from Medan to Yogyakarta the temperature is around 12°C. 3 requests to turn on the heating go ignored. It is blead-air, so abolutely no additional cost to turn on heating. But probably Lion-Air just wants to keep western tourists away from this wonderfull country… 😏 BTW: this seems to be a general concept. We were reminded several times to wear the mask, but 80% of locals run around the airport with the mask off or under their chin. And nobody cares…
reviews.author: Gulliver S

reviews.title: Avoid if you have a choice
reviews.text: Flew with them to Bali for a weekend hop. Wasn't really much choice in airlines to choose from but went ahead without expectations. Flights are delayed - no reason ever given, just changed. Waited almost 1 hour for the outbound. Aircraft is old and could do with a good clean, residue from goodness knows when splattered around the seat and seat pocket. AC was kept off (stating that it would start after take off ), never worked after take off, another way to save money... very uncomfortable Return was 2 hours late .... same issue with aircon. If there was a choice, i would pay a little more to fly comfortably and without the waiting around ... wasted a day with delays ... For a budget airline - otherwise ok. staff friendly
reviews.author: MP0072013

reviews.title: No problems at all
reviews.text: I've seen a lot of negativity about this airline but we had zero problems. More than that, it was actually a seamless experience and landed only 4 minutes after the scheduled time. We only had carryon luggage but was a LOVELY experience (I've had worse ryanair experiences). Love from Ireland
reviews.author: Cian Mc

reviews.title: The nightmare begins….
reviews.text: **Please Read** DO NOT USE THIS AIRLINE unless you want to cry , your children to cry , your family and friends to cry. They will delay flights , cancel flights , leave you stranded will say “ you are European , you can afford new flights” the staff will laugh whilst you cry. Blatantly tell you that they don’t care but will treat Indonesians differently. Some fellow passengers felt sorry for us 2 from Germany , 2 from France , 1 from UAE and were from the Uk. I have never experienced any airline like this it makes easy jet look like a plush airline and that is not a joke. We had a number of flights between Australia , Jakarta and Bali. This was in summer 2022.
reviews.author: Absi M

reviews.title: surprisingly problem free!
reviews.text: we had read some worrying reviews of lion air before flying with them but were surprisingly relieved to find the flight, although delayed, was relatively average. the planes themselves are worn out and could do with a revamp but for a budget airline, i thought the service and flight were completely bearable :)
reviews.author: meganw198410

reviews.title: DISASTROUS COMPANY
reviews.text: We have repeatedly given chances to Lion air and always disappointed us by delaying our flight, canceling it or making it impossible to reach our gate if not by running. The staff of Lionair are rude, disrespectful, useless and liars. We paid a direct flight to Jakarta from Labuan bajo, but apparently once we were in the airport the flight was a connection flight to surabaya. When we complained to the staff about no notifications whatsoever sent to us, they assured rudely that we didn’t have to leave the plane. Not only did they lie to our face about it, but we had to find out the last minute as we stayed in the plane as requested, that in fact, we had to go back and get another plane. There were no indications whatsoever about our flight, as they decided also to change our flight number and we were like imbeciles running around the airport trying to find our flight. THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE AND THEFT, THEY DO WHATEVER THEY WANT TO THEIR CUSTOMERS AND DON’T EVEN CARE IF THEY ARE DISRESPECTFUL AND RUDE IN THE PROCESS.
reviews.author: Alicia M

reviews.title: Worst Airline I've used! don't fly Lion Air!!
reviews.text: Absolutely the worst airline I have ever used. They changed the departure time 4 times in the days prior to the flight. Then on the actual day, it got delayed until the original time anyways. Cheap but crap! Recommend using another airline like citilink or AirAsia.
reviews.author: Jacob-Parent

reviews.title: Most horrible airline ever, do not recommend this airline to anyone
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight twice in just a few days before the flight would take place and 21 hours before. You have no guarantee that your flight will leave because they cancel everything. So do not book with this horrible company and just go with a different company that is much easier.
reviews.author: Emillianna G

reviews.title: Avoid at any cost!!!!!
reviews.text: No air con. No water. They change gates and boarding time without informing. Pathetic. It's, unhygienic, dirty and just not worth it. Pay a little extra go for other airline. I hope this airline shuts down because they don't treat you like humans but like parcels
reviews.author: Anurag

reviews.title: Find a way around this airline
reviews.text: Everything, is and will always be delayed. The worst part, they do not communicate with the passenger. For all you know the plane won't come, or the flight already left from another gate. They don't know eiher
reviews.author: Alwin M

reviews.title: Worst airline and customer service I ever experienced!!!
reviews.text: According to our booking we had a flight at 15.25 from Maumere to Denpasar with a layover at Makassar. When I looked up our flight number JT7341 in Google in the morning it said the flight was at 12.55. I did not receive any information about a flight change whatsoever so to be sure, I tried to get in touch with Lion Air's customer support to retrieve the correct information. Yet, no one took up the phone so I sent an email to three Lion Air customer care mail addresses. Up to this moment I have not received any response. Since there is only 1 flight to Denpasar we wanted to make sure we catched the flight hence we were at Maumere airport at 11.30 in order to be on time for the flight at 12.55, as mentioned on Google and on the website of Maumere airport. When we arrived at the airport the ground staff told us the flight was at 15.40, and the 12.55 flight was apparently according to the "old schedule", even though flight statuses get updated every few hours. Very saddened about this misinformation. Lion Air, please update your flight status more regularly and ensure your passengers receive the correct information at all places. We also did not receive any information about the schedule change from 15.25 to 15.40. While waiting at the airport, suddenly our flight was delayed for another 2 hours. This meant we would miss our connecting flight to Bali, which would depart at 18.10. We would also ave to stay the night somewhere around Makassar airport and miss our first activities which we booked on Bali. Once at Makassar Airport (20:00) we got our luggage and asked for a Proof of Delay statement. Creating this statement took very long (30 mins, we were already waiting since 11.30 on this day) and Lion Air could not provide us with a statement in English, just in Indonesian. We were happy to hear that Lion Air arranged an overnight stay at Darma Nusantara II, one of their hotels near the airport, including drop-off and pick-up. However, the hotel is super dirty. There are cockroaches and cats walking around the lobby and the rooms are also gross. We even had to ask for toiletpaper since there was none in our bathroom. We would really discourage booking this airline if you are considering it. We would also definititely not recommend going to this hotel. Try to book Ibis Budget hotel at the airport if you have the chance!! It's better to pay a bit more than to go to one of Lion Air's hotels for free. I really hope our next flight tomorrow morning at 09:30 will fly according to schedule without any hassle... :(
reviews.author: Nike v

reviews.title: Bad airlines
reviews.text: Travelled several times during my stay at Jakarta. Flights are not on time ever. You have to be alert yourself to gate changes. No water served. Air-conditioning does not work till take off. The wait between boarding and take off can be as much as an hour to an hour and half. So till then sweat it out. Bad leg space. Over all terrible experience.
reviews.author: Kavita Chowdhary

reviews.title: terrible
reviews.text: After a chaotic and delayed flight Jakarta - Pekanbaru (June 27th, JT290) I thought it couldn't become worse, but YES, it did. Flight JT291, Pekanbaru-Jakarta displayed delayed-terlambat, loudspeaker tells "stay in waiting room upon further information". 2 hours after the scheduled departure time I asked a Batk Air (member of Lion Group) staff - it will a lot more time, try to change the flight at the check-in counter. Long cue there, after 30 minutes or more: counter wanted to close just in front of me. Discussions, very unfriendly lady "ayo where is your boarding pass??" (on my phone, online check in) > neighbour counter. Flight changed to Batik Air, delay almost 4 hours. Original flight according to flightradar24.con cancelled, but on th monitors still diplayed as "delayed".
reviews.author: Jo_Pich

reviews.title: Delay, delay + chaos
reviews.text: monitor display: "on time" even after skeduled departure time. Gate change announced by boarding staff @ gate (not in English) but via loudspeaker still original gate. Delay > 1 hour. Back to Jakarta similar mess, "on time" but no boarding even 1 hour after scheduled departure time. Aircraft seats: pure torture.
reviews.author: Jo_Pich

reviews.title: Avoid Lion at all costs
reviews.text: Lion air is the poorest ran airline I have ever seen. They do a terrible job updating passengers on plane status and did not keep anyone in the loop how late it would be delayed. I had to check flightaware.com Fly Air Asia and avoid this terrible airline at all costs.
reviews.author: Brandt

reviews.title: Horrible airlines
reviews.text: They changed my transit flight to another flight more than TWENTY FOUR hours later and did not apologise, or offer a refund on cancellation, or even offer lounge or hotel passes for the layover! Absolutely horrible customer service. A truly garbage airline with truly garbage leadership and organisation. Would rather swim through shark infested waters than fly with them again.
reviews.author: Aditya R

reviews.title: Unbelievable
reviews.text: We arrived from Jakarta to Makassar and had to change our flight to Luwuk. Unfortunately, due to the one hour time difference between the the two cities, (Makassar 1 hour +), we missed our connecting flight (Our fault!) . It was the last availabe flight for the day. At the Lion Air Office in the Airport, the employees were very sorry for us and changed the flight for the next day, but wanted us to pay 166,00 € per PAX!!!! We then talked to the Head of the office, who was very very helpful and understanding. He issued us two Boarding Passes for the next flight wihout charging a Cent !!! I call that True Customer Service) Thank you so much.
reviews.author: sreepathy p

reviews.title: DOUBLE CHECK LUGGAGE INCLUDED
reviews.text: When booking with Lion Air Group, double check who your flight is with Lion Air Wings (IW flights) Batik If your flight is wings Air (will have IW before flight number). You will have NO check in luggage included. We got caught out as did others. Price for 20kg $65AUD !!!! Price for Wings Air Flight luggage 31,000 IDR PER KG OR PREPAID 25,000 PER KG We flew June 2022 to Lombok. On the upside the flight schedule was fairly smooth. Keep an eye on gate changes as well.
reviews.author: Cheryl S

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: Flight JT026 Sunday 29th May waiting I a holding area for well over an hour with no news and then buses to a completely different area of the airport not usually Lion Air area to wait again on the tarmac for 25 minutes..... Not direct notification of delays etc arrived at our hotel in Bali after midnight from a, 5.00pm flight supposedly from Jakarta. This is one of many bad expiritant with Lion. No more
reviews.author: Neil G

reviews.title: Worst airline ever!
reviews.text: The worst airline I have ever seen. The flight is delayed for 3 hours. Service is so slow. The gates keep changing.
reviews.author: Mery Z

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: My flight was rescheduled by the airline without any confirmation. Bad services, bad time management, overall is bad, just stay away from this airline.
reviews.author: Zidanne Ilham

reviews.title: Horrendous!
reviews.text: A day before the flight, Lion rescheduled to an hour later. Loaded into the plane 20 min late. Sat in a full plane without aircon, doors closed, no oxygen for 30 minutes. Everyone was hot, sweating, and furious. There was no announcement from the pilot or crew. Finally everyone was told to get off the plane. No further announcements were made for 30 minutes, after which it was said that there were technical issues and a new departure time of 9 PM (2.5 hrs after scheduled departure). From talking to the technical ground crew they said the plane had had technical issues on the previous flight but there had been no handover between crews. Turns out the plane was broken. Can't understand why they loaded all passengers into a full plane that wasn't fit to fly. Horrendous, will never ever fly Lion again.
reviews.author: HestS

reviews.title: Worst company ever
reviews.text: We had 2 flights with this company. First one delayed flight 4hours and they lost the luggage, missed the connection so we lost our hotel booking and 1 vacation day. We were stuck in a city we didn't aim. Second flight was the worst. One more time the flight was delayed so one more time we lost our connection to den Pasar which results in us stuck in semarang. They offer us the hotel for the night but when the transportation car came for the hotel the crew who was sharing the car with us evicted us from the car because we were complaining about the company. They ejected us very rudely saying here" no complaint"' we will only be able to travel tomorrow in the evening. Result of our 2 flights with them, luggage lost, 3 traveling days lost and most of all the crew from ketapang to semarang on the 5th of May treated us like sh**, and 2 booking in hotels lost due to the missing connection . We had to stay and to wait for an other transportation to the hotel for more than 1 hour. They may sent us to hotel but the food was not included and no compensation for our hotels booking lost due to missing check-in. Never experienced something like that. But I repeat the worst of everything was the attitude of the crew who evicted us from the transportation to the hotel.
reviews.author: Christophe D

reviews.title: Technical issues and delays
reviews.text: Substantial delay, zero compensation. No refreshments offered an hour into delay, strange lumps of tissue pushed along the air vents, very hot plane. Poor customer service.
reviews.author: Justin B

reviews.title: Unprofessional Lion Air Baggage Crew
reviews.text: My mom had a flight using Lion Air, it was okay, until she notice her stuffs in the baggage has thorn apart like it has open purposely by the crew. I don't know if that was the regulation of checking passenger's stuffs? The packaging has fragile sign on it. How can it be riped off like that? I really disappointed by this. I really hope Lion Air crew can do better in the future.
reviews.author: Achak

reviews.title: Lion Air always Delay
reviews.text: A few time flew with this airline is always disappointing me. Long time never think about flying anymore with name of LION AIR. And now when I tried to convinced me to trying to fly with them again. And its happened again.. DELAY.. LOL.. and today is 6 February 2022. And they're never change. So if you think to fly on time. Thsn Lion air is not the answer
reviews.author: Dendy O

reviews.title: Useless, Time-Wasting, Worst Airline in the World
reviews.text: Lion Air had the worst reputation in Indonesia, yet, pandemic has not changed them at all.. Still being the worst. None of the flight are on time.. Looks like they working on their own time.. Don't mind the schedule.. Delayed, give people snack box.. Done... Absolutely disgusting.. No apologies, no customer service, useless ground team with ZERO knowledge... Just looking at you with their dumb look on their face.. Telling you.. It's ok to be delayed.. Delay, broken plane, is normal for Lion, again.. The good example of don't care business.. I don't think the BOD of Lion will ever fly .. Or maybe they did.. Just don't care.. So it relay down.. If you travel business with tight schedule.. And you choose Lion.. Just tell your partner you will be 5-6 hours late.. Because that the average time of Lion Air delay..
reviews.author: Nikon2202

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever!
reviews.text: I was told not to fly with this airline because they can't be trusted, but they had the lowest cost so I thought why not give them a try and see for myself? Do not make this mistake, I have never been so frustrated at an airport in my life. I arrived at my flight 3 hours early thinking I was way too early and found out at check-in that the flight was canceled and transferred to a different airline and an EARLIER time, from 8pm to 6pm. This was my connection flight go back to the United States from Indonesia so I was immediately worried I would miss my flight. They directed me to customer service where there was a medium sized line of disgruntled people with similar issues. I was with my two friends who speak Indonesian and we got in line. After waiting 20 minutes not a single person in front of us had been successfully helped. Eventually a few people had been helped and we were next in line, but people who just showed up and went to the side of the line to the front and started asking for help and waving documents so of course the customer service agents gladly helped these people immediately and continued to ignore the next people in line who had been quietly waiting in line. Since we weren't getting anywhere, one of my friends went to the main Lion' Air check in line and asked for help again, the agent said they would help, so my friend waved us to come over so we got out of line and went towards her only to realize that this agent was walking towards the customer service agent to stand behind her and do nothing besides lose our place in line and let a few more people cut in front of us. Finally after an hour, they directed us to Batik Air where I was told that I needed to pay for my second bag even though I had already paid in advance. They asked for my receipt so I showed it to them and they STILL said that I hadn't paid for the extra bag even though it clearly showed two bags with up to 60 kg and the amount paid. I ended up paying double what I originally paid for the extra bag so I could make my flight in time and couldn't get a refund for the original baggage fee, which I verified I did pay. At no point did anyone apologize for this fiasco. I will never fly with these airlines again and I advise you to stay away as well.
